title: Ikey touch that
html_source: That is, a touch of the Jew or of the east. The ‘Freeman Journal’ was not thought by Arthur Griffiths to be truly nationalist (Thornton, W. Allusions in Ulysses, An Annotated List, p70).

anchor.prefix: r Griffith said about the headpiece over the Freeman leader: a homerule sun rising up in the northwest from the laneway behind the bank of Ireland. He prolonged his pleased smile.
